description: KernelSU-Next v3.3.0 integrated into the S688LN exact-stamp GKI kernel (kprobe hooks, additive).

features.desc: build.yml exposes a 'ksun' profile choice and routes it through the KSU integration + build path.
CI clones KSU-Next v3.3.0 and runs setup.sh so common/drivers/{Makefile,Kconfig} + symlink reference kernelsu (no core-source patches).
apply_tuning.sh ksun sets CONFIG_KSU=y (plus the KMI-safe bbr/zstd tier); build .config contains CONFIG_KSU=y.
Kleaf dist build completes and emits Image + boot.img for the ksun profile on the free runner.
Built kernel release string starts with 6.6.102-android15-8-g1481f357a31c (correct pinned source + KMI + stamp); full string logged.
Same-run signed rfkill.ko present, correct vermagic, 'Module signature appended' (v0.6 gate reused).
Root-agnostic WiFi/BT fix module zip (works under Magisk or KernelSU) built and attached to the ksun release.
OWNER-only gate: fastboot boot the ksun boot.img -> KSU root works + WiFi + BT + 248 modules. Not flashed blind.
